training_data_provenance.note: grade+usable heads train on TUAR+PhysioMotion only (see grade_training); the type head uses all five cohorts. This is the only shipped card whose training store carries a snapshot manifest, so it is the only one with a real digest.

license.code_license: MIT (app/LICENSE) — covers the app source, not these weights
source_terms: TUAR (TUH EEG Artifact Corpus): signed Temple University data use agreement required; the data may not be redistributed and the agreement does not address derived weights
license.note: provenance statement, not legal advice; verify each source's current terms before redistributing

feature_preprocessing.note: sqa_features.combined_vector (pack ++ advanced); graph z-scores x_raw and standardizes x_feat.

calibration.evaluation_partition: test (store_v8), restricted to the TUAR+PhysioMotion expert-grade cohorts these heads train on — the only shipped card whose reported ECE was already held out

held_out_ece.partition: data/store_v8 test split, TUAR+PhysioMotion — the same population grade_ece/usable_ece above report, re-measured through the shipped ONNX graph rather than the pre-export torch module
held_out_ece.population_kind: within_distribution: this graph trained on store_v8, so its own test split shares no subject with train or val (0 of 27 test subjects seen, measured)
held_out_ece.replication_note: this card needed no correction — the graph reproduces its own reported pair to within 0.0007 (grade 0.1269 -> 0.1270, usable 0.1632 -> 0.1625), which is what validates the harness that re-measured the other three cards

all_cohorts_store_v8_test.why_not_the_headline: the grade and usable heads are trained on TUAR+PhysioMotion only (grade_training below); the other three cohorts carry condition-derived proxy grades with no native ordinal quality scale, and on them the baked-in temperature makes grade calibration worse, not better (0.099 -> 0.2171). Reported so the cost of running this graph outside its label domain is on the card.

held_out_ece.pair_convention: [pre_scaling, as_shipped], same as grade_ece/usable_ece above. The graph emits raw_logits/T, so the pre-scaling logits are recovered exactly as graph_logits * T -- no model was loaded and the baked-in temperature is unchanged.
held_out_ece.estimator: biosqa.xdomain.calibration.expected_calibration_error at its default n_bins=15 (equal-width top-1-confidence bins) -- the same function and bin count that produced grade_ece/usable_ece above, so the two columns are comparable
held_out_ece.measured_by: scripts/measure_heldout_calibration.py (onnxruntime forward over this .onnx; trains nothing, exports nothing)

routing: grade+usable+type <- raw trunk fused with host combined vector; grade = ordinal ordered-logit; type = multilabel

grade_training.note: grade+usable trained only on signal-descriptive expert cohorts (TUAR, PhysioMotion) with confident-learning label cleaning; the type head trains on all cohorts. Proxy/condition-derived cohorts lack a native ordinal quality scale.
